name: splatoon3record
description: 基于采集卡的 Splatoon 3 录像、直播与对局归档工具
author: 澪度

scripts.dev: npm run build:ffmpeg && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "node build/watch.js"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.lint: npm run check:naming && eslint src tests build
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.build:electron: node build/clean.js && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node build/rename.js
scripts.build: npm run build:ffmpeg && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never --config electron-builder.cjs
